workflow_runs.name: Mirror
workflow_runs.display_title: feat(i18n): add runtime localisation with six UN languages

head_commit.message:
feat(i18n): add runtime localisation with six UN languages

- Add src/ui/i18n.rs: Locale enum, English-keyed catalogs embedded from
  locales/*.json, `tr!` macro with format!-style placeholders, and locale
  persistence/startup detection
- Wrap user-facing UI strings across src/ui in `crate::tr!`
- Add locales/{en,zh-CN,fr,es,ru,ar}.json (306 entries each, covering nav,
  page chrome, buttons and common messages); missing keys fall back to English
- Replace the sidebar language control with a click-to-select dropdown
  (flags + endonyms, current entry checked)
- Keep i18n tooling under temp/i18n/ and document the flow in README
